why: Both Century Communities and KB Home are US national homebuilders that design, build and sell new residential homes (single-family, townhomes, condos) directly to individual homebuyers, supported by affiliated mortgage and title services. They operate in overlapping states (TX, FL, CO, AZ, WA among others) and target the same buyer segments (first-time, move-up buyers). Product and customer overlap is essentially complete.
reason: Century Communities builds and sells new construction homes (single-family, townhomes, condos) to individual homebuyers across 16 US states [T:P1.7, T:P2.4], with ancillary mortgage, title and insurance services [T:P2.5, T:P2.6, T:P2.7]. KB Home does the same — building new homes in 10 overlapping states [C:P1.4] and selling them to individual buyers [C:P1.2, C:P1.3], with design-studio personalization and mortgage/title affiliates. Same product, same buyer, same business model.

primary_products.reason: Both build and sell new single-family homes, townhomes and condos to homebuyers.

primary_services.reason: Century Communities offers mortgage, title and insurance services; KB Home offers design-studio personalization and comparable mortgage/title affiliates. Both anchor ancillary services to their homebuying process.

customer_segment.reason: Both sell directly to individual (B2C) homebuyers looking for new construction.

end_markets.reason: Both operate exclusively in US residential new-home construction.

business_model.reason: Both are OEM homebuilders: acquire land, build homes using subcontractors, sell to end buyers. Identical operating model.

revenue_model.reason: Revenue driven by home sales to buyers, supplemented by mortgage/title/insurance service fees — same structure at both companies.

value_chain_position.reason: Both sit at the OEM/builder position: they convert land and materials into finished homes sold directly to end consumers.

geography_served.reason: Both are US national builders with significant state overlap (TX, FL, CO, AZ, WA, NC); Century is in 16 states vs KB Home's 10 states, so not identical but highly overlapping.

specialization.reason: Both specialize in new residential construction with integrated buyer services (mortgage, title, design). Same niche.

distribution_channels.reason: Both use on-site sales staff, model homes, online purchasing tools, and third-party buyer brokers.

regulatory_exposure.reason: Both face the same regulatory environment: land use/zoning, building codes, environmental rules, mortgage lending regulations (CFPB/RESPA), and warranty/construction-defect laws.
